mapper.sql: FROM wf_lifecycle_delivery d JOIN wf_lifecycle_event e ON e.event_id = d.event_id AND e.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.status = #{status}
mapper.select: SELECT d.event_id, d.subscriber_key, d.status, d.attempt_count, d.next_attempt_at, d.last_error, d.delivered_at, e.event_type, e.business_type, e.business_key, e.business_round, e.business_title, e.occurred_at ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
